messages:
Sam W: Heads up — spikes in OOMs on p4 fleet when serving AWQ/GPTQ FP8 model variants after yesterday's kernel-routing change. Started ~12:40 UTC, affecting long-context jobs.
Leila N: Seen similar alerts. Any quick repro or profile?
Sam W: Yup. Profiling shows kernel selector picking a fused-attn path that increases per-layer workspace ~20% versus baseline. Combined with KV cache lazy-upcast to fp16 we blow past capacity on longer seqs.
Kai T: Can you paste the profiler snippet and KV dtype breakdown?
Sam W: ```
# pprof heap snapshot (slice)
TotalAllocated: 12.1 GB
- kernel_workspace: 5.2 GB
- kv_cache_buffers: 4.6 GB
- temp_scratch: 1.1 GB
- fragmentation_overhead: 1.2 GB
```
Also runtime dtype map: AWQ activations = uint8 on disk, but runtime KV store kept as fp16 due to the lazy-upcast compatibility shim.
Leila N: That lazy-upcast was enabled in kernel-routing-v2 to avoid precision bugs for some fused kernels. Side effect: KV doubles in memory for long contexts.
Kai T: Two mitigation axes: adjust kernel selector to consider workspace + kv footprint when choosing fused kernels, or change KV handling (compact store + upcast-on-read). Which is less disruptive short-term?
Sam W: Short-term safe move: reduce allocator.workspace_margin for p4 pool from 0.35 -> 0.2 and disable KV lazy-upcast for AWQ models only. Infra rollback already in flight.
R&D-bot: Deploy bot: rolled back kernel-routing-v2 -> kernel-routing-v1 on affected hosts at 13:05 UTC.
Leila N: Practical repro command I used: ```
run_serving --model galactica-awq --quant awq --batch_hint 8 --force-kv-upcast=false
```
That hit OOM in ~90s before rollback.
Kai T: We should add a kernel_cost_estimator in selector: estimate_workspace(model, seq, batch) + kv_est(model, seq, locals_cache) and prefer path with lower total memory. Also annotate model profiles with kv_dtype footprint to allow model-catalog hints.
Sam W: Agreed. I'll run stress job with these vars: ```--simulated-kv-fp16=disabled --workspace-margin=0.25 --batch_hint=6``` and post results.
Leila N: Also consider a short-lived buffer-reuse window: reuse freed temp_scratch for next request within X ms to reduce churn. Tight window reduces fragmentation.
Kai T: I'll open a perf PR to add estimator + selector gating + metric emission (kv_bytes_per_active_seq). Then console can show per-route kv utilization and recommend batch_hint/quant profiles.
Sam W: Filed issue 4823 with repro, traces, pprof and stack samples. Pinged @Kai T for follow-ups.
Leila N: Ops note: if you see prod OOMs, temporarily pin kernel-routing to v1 and bump p4 autoscale. We'll not revert AWQ quant changes, just conservatively scope lazy-upcast.
infra-bot: Alert policy updated: rule "kv_bytes > 0.6 * gpu_mem" -> notify eng-runtime
Kai T: Will add unit tests for estimator accuracy and a flamegraph test to ensure we don't regress workspace in future.
Sam W: Thanks all — will post stress results later today :thumbsup:
thread_description: investigation into OOM spikes caused by kernel selection + KV upcast interplay; short-term mitigations and long-term selector + metrics plan
